result.statistical_method: Table 2 footnote b: mixed model for time-by-randomization-group interaction, adjusted for age and sex; patient as random effect. The main-text primary-outcome description uses linear-regression wording; the directly matching table analysis is retained here. The primary 3-month analysis follows intention to treat and uses multiple imputation by predictive mean matching with 10 completed datasets, using baseline sex, age, BMI, tobacco consumption and VAS pain as covariates; results are combined across imputations. This imputation description applies to the primary adjusted contrast, not to descriptive medians or observed participant counts.
